CREDIT BY CREDIT

Weighted & unweighted GPA.

Transcript seeding uses numeric FINAL grades when present; otherwise it averages available numeric SEM1 / SEM2 grades for each course. Only positive-credit rows are included. This is a planning conversion; review course eligibility and bonuses.

Enter final grades and earned/attempted credits from your transcript for a transcript-based estimate, or use current averages for planning. Set each course’s bonus explicitly. Repeats, exclusions, and district cohort rules require counselor review. Nothing here is an official Irving ISD GPA.

Conversion scale & transcript CSV

Generic defaults: 90 → 4, 80 → 3, 70 → 2, 60 → 1, below 60 → 0. These are editable planning thresholds, not the district’s verified conversion table. Bonuses apply only above 0 base points.

Download blank template

Columns: course, grade, credits, bonus. UTF-8 CSV; numeric grades from 0–100. This imports a CSV you prepare from a transcript, not a PDF or an official HAC transcript. Import replaces the calculator’s rows; imported data stays on this page until you leave.

UNWEIGHTED GPA—Weighted by course credits
WITH COURSE BONUSES—Using your bonus values
WHAT-IF GPA—Unweighted projection
WHAT-IF + BONUSES—Weighted projection
CourseGrade %What-if %CreditsBonusRemove

Formula: Σ(grade points × credits) ÷ Σ(credits). Blank what-if scores use the current grade. Rows with incomplete values produce a validation message, never a guessed grade. This calculator is cleared when you leave or switch the imported HAC view.
